title: XQS Black Cherry Nicotine Pouches - 8mg/Pouch
description: XQS Black Cherry tastes dark and fruity with gentle tartness, keeping the Cherry note clear and balanced from start to finish. Each slim, all‑white pouch sits neatly under the lip and releases nicotine gradually without smoke, vapour or noticeable odour. This can contains 20 pouches in 8mg (Strong). Made in Sweden by XQS, the range is built around familiar flavours presented in a straightforward, discreet format. Nicotine Ranges: Strong - 8mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
